vintage_note: Vintage cutoff 30 Oct 2026. Uses only prints available on or before that date. No forward fill of later releases.
lending_implications: Household demand / confidence soft. Sentiment is below its own history, which pressures discretionary personal loans and BNPL. Keep salary verification strict. Vars: Consumer sentiment (ICS).
Activity mix uneven. Goods-movement and construction-adjacent series are soft. Prefer salaried and GST-registered self-employed borrowers. Vars: Core cement, E-way bills, IIP Mining, Core steel.
Digital payments are decelerating versus their own trend. UPI is still up year on year but below trend. Pause aggressive limit increases for thin-file digital-only customers. Vars: UPI value.
Cash-stress proxies. Rising ATM and AePS use is inverted, so an increase marks rural and semi-urban liquidity stress. Vars: ATM (NFS) volume, AePS cash withdrawals.
System credit backdrop. Bank credit is still firm versus history. Defend cutoffs against adverse selection if competitors ease. Vars: Bank credit, Non-food bank credit.
